summary: Approval request: timeboxed production session extract with field-level redaction for enterprise incident
description: Issue summary: Customer FinNova reported suspected leakage of masked account tokens in a support transcript. We are requesting a timeboxed, minimal extract of production session payloads and trace fragments to reproduce and confirm whether tokenization or KV cache isolation failed. Impact: Potential exposure of masked tokens affecting <50 customers; enterprise contract requires timely investigation. Request: Approval to provision an encrypted, access-controlled extract limited to explicit session IDs and a 48-hour access window. Scope: Include only the requested session IDs and +/- 2 minutes of surrounding request/response pairs; exclude unrelated sessions. Redaction: Apply field-level redaction template REDACT-T3; replace emails and identifiers with hashed placeholders; mask numeric sequences that resemble account numbers. Retention: Extract retained for 72 hours and auto-deleted. Dual-control: Two-person KMS unseal (Security approver + Oncall SRE) required to access decrypted content. Audit: Full access logging, KMS audit, and an S3 access manifest will be captured. Requestor contact: Aisha Kaur (Support); Customer SOC: j.sullivan@finnova.com.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer submits transcript showing token-like strings in chat output. 2) Support locates session IDs and timestamps from prod logs. 3) Request a narrow log slice for those sessions. 4) Run automated REDACT-T3 template and generate encrypted archive. 5) Two-person KMS unseal in isolated sandbox for reproduction.
investigation_notes: Support (2026-03-10): Found three candidate sessions in the customer's window. KV cache keys present near 2026-03-09T18:42:xxZ. Hypotheses: (A) Telemetry pipeline accidentally captured unmasked metadata; (B) KV cache prefix collision allowed cross-tenant caching. SRE (Priya Sharma): Local reproduction possible with redacted inputs, but full validation requires original token boundaries from production traces. Security (Miguel Ortiz): Requires stricter minimization before any external handoff.
comments: Aisha Kaur (Support) 2026-03-10: Filed initial request and linked Slack thread #support-finnova (thread A-B). Marked as P1 due to enterprise SLA.

Miguel Ortiz (Security) 2026-03-11: Please tighten scope: remove any full-sentence outputs that contain financial account-like patterns unless explicitly required. Legal sign-off required for regulated data handling.
Priya Sharma (SRE) 2026-03-11: I can provision the sandbox and run the cache replay. Will need two-person KMS unseal; please include exact session IDs when approved.
Legal (Rachel Lin) 2026-03-11: Confirmed FinNova submitted DPA amendment; recommend masking additional account-like numeric sequences. Awaiting signature scan.
Aisha Kaur (Support) 2026-03-12: Uploaded REDACT-T3 template and hash-mapping script to PR #2491. Requested expedited security review.
resolution: Pending approval. Interim mitigations executed: advised customer to rotate suspected tokens and revoke affected API keys; applied tenant-level extra logging and tightened rate limits to limit further exposure. Planned workflow upon approval: (1) Security approves redaction and Legal confirms DPA; (2) SRE generates KMS-wrapped extract in an isolated S3 path with TTL=72h; (3) Security + SRE perform reproduction and produce a short findings summary; (4) Archive deleted and findings attached to ticket.
audit_trail: Slack: #support-finnova (thread A-B); GH PRs: platform/pull/2491, security/pull/118; Confluence: Minimal Redaction SOP. KMS request will include approver ARNs and CloudTrail logs.
